indicator_name: Statutory tax and contribution rates: VAT, corporate and personal income tax, social tax, social and pension contributions, medical insurance, mineral extraction tax on metals, excises, export duty on crude oil, monthly
description: Законодательные ставки налогов и обязательных взносов: НДС, КПН, ИПН, социальный налог, социальные отчисления, пенсионные взносы, ОСМС, НДПИ на металлы, акцизы, вывозная пошлина на нефть, помесячно
unit: % (excises: KZT per tonne or per 1 000 sticks; oil export duty: USD per tonne) -- see item_name
methodology: Hand-kept (config/tax_rates.yaml): the rate in force in each month, read in the text of the act that set it (acts and articles are listed in the file). A month is ABSENT when its level was not read in a legal text or when there was no single rate: CIT 2009-2010 (transitional article not read), social tax 2002-2008 (2004-2008 regressive scales), dividends 2018-2022, metals MET 2018-2022, gold and uranium MET from 2026 (scales by price and output), petrol excise 2018-01..2019-05, cigarettes 2011-2013, oil export duty before 2012 and from March 2016 (price-linked: 0 below 25 USD/bbl, USD/t equal to the price in USD/bbl for 25-105). VAT 16 from 2001-07, 15 from 2004, 14 from 2007, 13 from 2008, 12 from 2009, 16 from 2026-01. Social tax 11 from 2009, 9.5 from 2018, 11 from 2025, 6 from 2026; in 2018-2025 the amount payable was the tax minus social contributions, so the net rate was 6 (2018-2024) and 6 (2025). PIT_TOP is the highest bracket: 20 in 2004-2006, 10 (flat) in 2007-2025, 15 above 8 500 MRP of annual income from 2026. Employer pension contributions 1.5 / 2.5 / 3.5 in 2024 / 2025 / 2026 (4.5 and 5 legislated for 2027 and 2028). Not here: the oil MET scale (5-18 % by annual output, unchanged 2011-2026), rent tax on export, reduced VAT rates (medicines 5 in 2026), special regimes. Налоговые кодексы 2001, 2008, 2017 и 2025 гг., законы о внесении изменений, Социальный кодекс, закон об ОСМС, постановления Правительства и приказы о ставках акцизов и вывозных пошлин; тексты по zakon.uchet.kz (зеркало adilet.zan.kz), сверено 2026-11-13.
